subject: music
title: Dynamics and Articulation
welcome_lead: From pp to fff and staccato to legato.
meta_desc: A-Level Music: dynamics, articulation marks, and performance directions.
final_note: Markings are the composer's voice to the performer.

concepts.def: Symbols indicating volume: pp, p, mp, mf, f, ff.

walkthroughs.body_html: The ladder: pp (pianissimo), p, mp, mf, f, ff (fortissimo). Extreme markings up to ppppp (Tchaikovsky) and ffff appear in late-Romantic scores.
Staccato dots = short, detached. Legato slurs = smooth connection. Marcato hat = emphatic. Tenuto dash = held to full value with slight stress.
Spelt cresc./dim. or notated as hairpins. A crescendo hairpin opens; diminuendo closes. Always identify start and end dynamics.

numericals.q: How many standard dynamic markings between pp and ff (inclusive: pp, p, mp, mf, f, ff)?
